newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA confirms discussing Sempati stake.
newsitem.headline: SIA confirms discussing Sempati stake.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd (SIA) confirmed on Thursday it was negotiating for a stake in private Indonesian carrier PT Sempati.

"We can...confirm that discussions have taken place with Sempati on an equity-based relationship, and these discussions are continuing. We shall not disclose any further details until we are ready to do so," SIA said in a statement to Reuters.
SIA was responding to queries following reports in local newspapers that it may take a minority stake in Sempati.
Analysts said such a stake would be positive.
"Provided the equity stake is substantial (though not likely to be more than 50 percent) we see this development as positive for SIA," Fraser Securities said in a note to clients.

It said a deal would create inroads for SIA into the huge domestic and international air travel market in Indonesia and provide passenger and cargo feeds for the company's international network out of Singapore.
But initial reaction from dealers was less positive.
Shares in SIA's local share tranche fell five cents to Singapore S$7.35 by 0400 GMT.
